title: Growth config: ATTRIBUTION_MODELS
description: Reporting models only (GRW-P3-B): windows, half-life, position shares and the data-driven gate. NEVER read by the money decision (ATTRIBUTION_POLICY owns that); no model changes a commission. Added in 1.13.0. PROPOSED_DEFAULT until ratified. Unknown keys rejected.

webAppDays.description: Web and app touch window. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 30.

positionFirstBp.description: Position-based first-touch share in basis points. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 4000.

positionLastBp.description: Position-based last-touch share. positionFirstBp + positionLastBp must not exceed 10000. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 4000.

minConversions.description: Attended new patients needed in the lookback before the data-driven model runs. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 1000.

minNodeK.description: Paths a node must occur in before it is shown; smaller nodes are folded. Never below 10.
